shortDescription: Cancer drugmaker BeOne Medicines SSE:688235 said it signed a voluntary agreement with the U.S. government to expand access to its medicines.The company said it commits to pricing future U.S. Food and Drug Administration-approved medicines in line with prices in other major developed countries.
